"""RoboWits seal_colander episode client record.

The service was unavailable during this attempt, so no actions were issued.
If the service becomes available, this script captures the live spec and the
initial RGB/proprioception state for a camera-grounded control run.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot


OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    robot = Robot(timeout=600)
    spec = robot.spec()
    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")

    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
    (OUT / "initial_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"initial_{camera}.png")
    print("Service connected; spec and initial camera observations saved.")
    print("Episode metadata:", obs.meta)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
